text:
Ari: Hey team — final draft of the launch blog is ready for a quick pass. Doc: https://docs.google.com/launch-draft (Figma comps in the doc). Needs: benchmark sanity check, legal claim scrub, hero CTA copy, and HubSpot mapping for webinar registration. Target publish: Tue 10am PT. Please reply with edits or ✅ by EOD. @Priya @Sam @Theo @Jordan @Lena

Priya: Quick note on the benchmark section — we currently say '3–4x faster than open-source baseline' — can we change to 'up to 3x' and cite our p50 latency comparison? Will paste numbers in a sec.

Priya: Benchmark snippet:
```
Model A (Redwood-opt): p50 45ms
Model B (baseline): p50 135ms
=> 3x
```

Theo: Hero image needs a vertical crop for mobile. Also CTA currently 'Try it' — suggest 'Try Redwood Inference' for clarity and SEO. Uploading two variants to the Figma file now.

Sam: Legal: flagging a couple of claims — remove 'enterprise-grade' unless we can back it, and drop 'guaranteed 99.9%' from the blog (we have SLA in Dedicated docs but can't promise in a marketing post). Also avoid direct competitor comparisons by name.

Jordan: For HubSpot mapping, propose this minimal map — please confirm: 
```
form_id: launch_webinar_2026
utm_source: newsletter
utm_campaign: launch_apr
webhook: https://hooks.redwood.example/webhook/launch
```
I'll add this to the publish playbook and wire the webhook.

Lena: Copy nits: headline suggestion — change 'Low-latency LLM inference for product teams' -> 'Fast, reliable LLM inference for product teams'. Also 'cost/performance toolkit' -> 'cost and performance toolkit'. Small comma fixes in the hero paragraph.

Ari: Thanks all. Priya — can you paste the final graph and confirm the phrasing 'up to 3x' so I can update the draft? Sam — we'll remove the SLA line and the enterprise phrase and add a footnote pointing readers to Dedicated SLA info. Theo — update the CTA string and drop the vertical/mobile hero into the doc. Jordan — add HubSpot form + webhook URLs to the publish checklist and share the Confluence link here. Lena — will take your copy tweaks and run a final sweep.

MarketingBot: Reminder: publish checklist run scheduled Mon 9:00am PT. I will ping this channel then.

Priya: ✅ Updated the copy in the doc to 'up to 3x' and uploaded the latency graph: https://storage.redwood/bench-graphs/launch-p50.png

Jordan: Mapping added to the playbook and webhook configured. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/launch-playbook#publish (form id: launch_webinar_2026).

Sam: Confirming legal OK with removals — approve the post as edited :thumbsup:

Theo: Uploaded two hero variants to Figma and updated CTA to 'Try Redwood Inference'.

Ari: Final pass scheduled Mon AM. If there are no more objections, I'll lock the doc by 9am PT and queue the publish flow. Thanks team :rocket:
